title: Technical Writer - IfU
description:
**Work Schedule**


Standard (Mon\-Fri)**Environmental Conditions**


Office**Job Description**


As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Create, revise, and publish high\-quality **Instructions for Use (IFU)** in alignment with current procedures, regulatory expectations, and market needs.
* Ensure documentation complies with **QSR, ISO**, and other internal quality and regulatory standards.
* Coordinate translation activities with external translation agencies and internal stakeholders to ensure linguistic accuracy and timely delivery.
* Maintain adherence to company **style guides**, templates, and quality management systems (QMS).
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with teams such as **Product Development, Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance, Marketing, and Global Operations** to gather information and validate technical accuracy.
* Drive and manage activities within the assigned area of responsibility.
* Contribute to the **continous improvement** of documentation standards, templates, and processes.
* Support **Deviation, CAPA, and complaint investigations** by providing documentation expertise and contributing to corrective action processes.

**Qualifications \& Experience**

* **Bachelor’s or Master’s degree** in Technical Communication, English, Journalism, Life Sciences (e.g., Biology, Biochemistry, Molecular Biology), or a related field; equivalent professional experience will be considered.
* **2–3 years of technical writing experience** within the life sciences, medical device, or in vitro diagnostics (IVD) industry.
* **Excellent English,** including speaking, writing, and editing skills.
* Strong understanding of **regulated content development**, including usability, risk communication, and labeling requirements.
* Hands\-on experience with **content management systems (CMS/CCMS)**, ideally in **DITA/XML** structured authoring environments.
* Proven ability to manage multiple documentation projects in a **global, fast\-paced, and regulated environment**.
* Experience working with **translations and simplified English.**
* Experience with **EU IVDR** documentation requirements.

**Preferred Skills**

* Proven ability to create **clear, compliant, and user\-friendly content** for laboratory technicians, clinicians, and regulatory reviewers.
* **Multilingual skills** (e.g., German, French, Spanish) to support localization and translation processes.
* Experience in use of **reusable content strategies** to drive consistency and efficiency.
* Strong **cross\-cultural communication and collaboration skills**, with flexibility to work in a dynamic, global team setting.
* High **attention to detail,** accuracy, and a commitment to continuous improvement.
* Demonstrated t**echnical curiosity and interest** in understanding complex products and systems.
* Good **collaborator with clear communication skills**.
* Ability to work both independently and in collaboration with others, as well as the ability to handle both small and large tasks.
* Experience with **EU MDR** is an advantage.

title: Tech writer
description:
**Job Requirements**  

At Quest Global, it’s not just what we do but how and why we do it that makes us different. With over 25 years as an engineering services provider, we believe in the power of doing things differently to make the impossible possible. Our people are driven by the desire to make the world a better place—to make a positive difference that contributes to a brighter future. We bring together technologies and industries, alongside the contributions of diverse individuals who are empowered by an intentional workplace culture, to solve problems better and faster.

 **Job Description:**


The Technical Writer will be responsible for creating and maintaining support material such as Product Manuals, procedures for O\&G tools from Content Management tool. As a member of a small, dynamic documentation team and an integral part of the enterprise organization within an agile environment, he or she will make sure that instructional guides and reference manuals are clear enough for new users and detailed enough for advanced ones.

 **Essential Responsibilities:**

* Generate technical content from existing documentation and tool manuals of O\&G tools
* Strategize, Plan and execute content level and description
* Collaborate with SME and AMO technicians and suggest Event\-based Maintenance (EBM) strategies instead of Levels of Maintenance (LoM) based on tools usage and repair cycles
* Interact with technicians (end\-users) and update chunks for improved productivity
* Write engaging content from AMO's technician point of view

 **Requirements:**

* Have proven skills in describing and explaining complex concepts and procedures
* Candidate should possess 5\-10 years of experience in technical writing
* Clear Strategic thinker and team skills are critical
* Coordinate with Global teams and attend calls during the off\-hours, if needed
* Have excellent written/verbal communication skills, particularly in English
* Be an excellent team player
* Be able to work under pressure and meet all deadlines
* Can work with minimal supervision in a very dynamic work environment

  

We wholeheartedly believe in the diversity of thought that comes with fostering a culture rooted in respect, where everyone belongs, is valued, and feels inspired to share their ideas. We know embracing our unique differences makes us better, and that solving the worlds hardest engineering problems requires diverse ideas, perspectives, and backgrounds. We shine the brightest when we tap into the many dimensions that thrive across over 21,000 difference\-makers in our workplace.

 **Work Experience**  

**Desired Characteristics:**

* Have worked on user documentation, preferably online as well as PDF
* Content Management and application development know\-how would be a plus
* Experience with Content Management modeling tools
* Experience with various documentation tools (e.g. Documentum)
* General knowledge on agile software development

**Tools**


Proficiency in MS Office, Adobe InDesign, Adobe Illustrator, XML authoring (Arbor text/Madcap Flare etc.)

**Additional skills**

* CAD tools such as SolidWorks, etc.

**Candidate Background and competencies**


Education \& Experience

* BE/B tech or equivalent degree in Mechanical Engineering
* 3\-5 years of experience as a Technical Writer skill.
* Experience in industrial equipment and systems comprising of Mechanical, Electronics and Software functionality will be a plus**.**

title: Specialist Technical Writer
description:
Are you passionate about turning complex engineering concepts into clear, customer\-friendly documentation? We are looking for a detail\-oriented Technical Documentation Specialist to create, maintain, and publish high\-quality technical content, including datasheets, user manuals, application notes, process guidelines, and customer instructions. This role partners closely with engineering Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to transform technical information into accurate, professional, and publication\-ready documentation while ensuring adherence to documentation standards, style guides, and structured authoring principles.  

Your role  

Key responsibilities in your new role

  

* Create and maintain technical customer documentation, such as datasheets, user manuals, application notes, process guidelines, and customer instructions
* Support Subject Matter Experts (engineers) in transforming technical information into clear, accurate, and publication\-ready documentation
* Execute technical documentation activities using established templates, standards, and workflows
* Ensure the quality, consistency, formatting, and linguistic accuracy of technical documentation before publication
* Apply and maintain technical documentation standards, terminology, style guides, and structured authoring principles
* Support the review, approval, publication, and maintenance of technical documents throughout the product lifecycle
* Identify and flag content issues, inconsistencies, missing information, and deviations from documentation standards
* Collaborate with engineering and business stakeholders to ensure timely delivery of documentation

  

Your profile  

Qualifications and skills to help you succeed

  

* A professional education in technical communication or a degree in engineering, computer science, natural sciences, or a similar field
* Already been experienced in technical writing, technical communication, or documentation activities
* A structured, precise, and quality\-oriented way of working
* The ability to understand and communicate complex technical information clearly and effectively
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously
* A collaborative mindset and the ability to work effectively with engineers and other stakeholders in an international environment
* Familiarity with documentation tools, content management systems, or structured authoring methodologies Excellent communication skills and a strong customer\-oriented mindset
* Very high professional proficiency in written and spoken English; additional languages are a plus
* Experience with XML\-based authoring environments, ideally DITA XML is a plus
* Knowledge of AI technologies, including Large Language Models (LLMs)and AI\-assisted content creation tools, is a plus
* A strong interest in digitalization, automation, and modern documentation technologies is a plus
* This role is ideal for candidates who enjoy combining technical understanding, structured information management, and clear communication to support the creation of high\-quality technical documentation.

  

\#WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization.  

As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power systems and IoT, Infineon enables game\-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. Together, we drive innovation and customer success, while caring for our people and empowering them to reach ambitious goals. Be a part of making life easier, safer and greener.  

Are you in?  

  

We are on a journey to create the best Infineon for everyone.

  

We strive to create the best Infineon for everyone by embracing diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants for who they are and offer a workplace built on trust, openness, respect and equal opportunity.


Our hiring decisions are based on skills and experience. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply.


Please let your recruiter know if you need any accommodations during the interview process.


Learn more about our various contact channels and about Diversity \& Inclusion at Infineon.

title: Technical Writer
description:
**Job Requirements**  

At Quest Global, it’s not just what we do but how and why we do it that makes us different. With over 25 years as an engineering services provider, we believe in the power of doing things differently to make the impossible possible.  **Key Responsibilities**

* Content Creation: Write comprehensive user manuals, Business process documents and other documentation from various input sources like Drafts, Spreadsheets, Videos, etc.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with subject matter experts (SMEs), engineers, and process owners to gather the requirements and create the required documents
* Standardization: Maintain a consistent style and voice across all technical documentation using industry standard frameworks. Follow customer standards for documentation
* Visual Integration: Incorporate diagrams, CAD screenshots, and flowcharts to enhance document clarity.
* Lifecycle Management: Maintain the document management process like naming \& numbering convention, revision control, etc.

  

We are known for our extraordinary people who make the impossible possible every day. Questians are driven by hunger, humility, and aspiration. We believe that our company culture is the key to our ability to make a true difference in every industry we reach. Our teams regularly invest time and dedicated effort into internal culture work, ensuring that all voices are heard.

  

We wholeheartedly believe in the diversity of thought that comes with fostering a culture rooted in respect, where everyone belongs, is valued, and feels inspired to share their ideas. We know embracing our unique differences makes us better, and that solving the worlds hardest engineering problems requires diverse ideas, perspectives, and backgrounds. We shine the brightest when we tap into the many dimensions that thrive across over 21,000 difference\-makers in our workplace.

 **Work Experience**  

* Experience: 5\+ years of technical writing experience, specifically within an engineering, manufacturing, or industrial automation environment.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Technical Communication or related field
* Tools: Proficiency with authoring tools such as Google Suite, Lucid, Visio, MadCap Flare, Adobe FrameMaker, or Oxygen XML Author, as well as Git/Markdown
* Core Skills: Ability to read the draft documents, engineering drawings, process charts and understand the intent of the document. Ability to interpret the intent and processes from process videos and SME interviews to generate documents
* Should have exceptional editing skills; strong grasp of structured authoring
* Document Management: Ability to understand the document management control process like JIRA or equivalent.

title: Documentation Tools Manager
description:
**Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human**  

  

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real\-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.  

  

This is an opportunity to do career\-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.



We are looking for a manager to lead the Documentation (Doc) Tools team supporting the Builder Experience department. Reporting to the Information Development Director, you will be leading a team of engineers who support the help.okta.com and developer.okta.com sites as well as the teams who contribute and create content for those sites (Information Development, Builder Advocacy, and Content Strategy).

  

What you’ll be doing
* Lead a team of engineers responsible for building and maintaining the help.okta.com and developer.okta.com content sites.
* You’ll lead the adoption of AI across your team’s day\-to\-day deliverables, integrating it thoughtfully to improve your internal stakeholder’s productivity, quality, and speed.
* Work closely with the Doc Tools leads to develop and implement our roadmap.
* Recruit great engineers to accelerate our work.
* Mentor, retain, and develop engineers as they advance in their own careers.
* Establishing clear priorities, expectations, and accountability for individuals and team
* Collaborate with the Doc Tools leads to assist in delivering projects on the Builder Experience roadmap.

What you’ll bring to the role
* Have managed software engineering teams with end\-to\-end ownership over their technical stack and production performance.
* Hands\-on experience with AI\-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Codex and Claude, with the ability to integrate them effectively into day\-to\-day engineering workflows.
* Are excited to build an amazing product \- and believe the best way to do so is by leading and empowering engineers.
* Are familiar with CI/CD tools such as GitHub, CircleCI, Vercel and Artifactory.
* Have successfully built high\-performing engineering teams.
* Have opinions on topics like build tooling, CI/CD pipelines and technical debt.
* Are comfortable leading geographically distributed teams.
* Thrive on autonomy, and use it to get stuff done.

Desired knowledge
* Experience working with a documentation team.
* Knowledge of DITA, documentation tools, and writer processes.
* Localization experience.

Required education and experience:
* 10\+ years of experience as an engineer with significant frontend experience.
* 3\+ years of experience building and leading a team of engineers.
* Deep understanding of at least 1 major cloud provider (AWS/Azure/GCP)
* 3\+ years of technical management experience.
* Bachelor's in CS, or equivalent
